scenes.caption: What if a city suddenly began dancing—and could not stop? In Strasbourg, in the summer of 1518, one exhausted woman began to move in the street. Then another joined her. Soon, the city was watching a frightening outbreak no one understood.
scenes.visual_evidence: an ordinary civic square becomes threatening as one clearly distressed dancer draws alarmed witnesses
scenes.emotional_turn: normality breaks into an inexplicable public crisis
historical_constraints: Depict the 1518 dancing outbreak as a documented but contested historical episode; do not present supernatural causation as fact.
